"Hot Seat"
The premise
Most people have incredible branding.
A logo they love. Colours that feel right. A website that looks the part.
And yet — online, they still don't sound quite like themselves.
This is about fixing that.

"She'd tweaked it so much for the algorithm that she'd lost her essence entirely."

In this production
EMMA GIBBS-NG
Leads the conversation. Draws out what you mean, not what you think you should say.
NINA OLIVER
Directs the day. Timestamps the moments that land.
DOM
On camera. Two angles. Finds what the day uncovered in the edit.
Before the day
YOU DON'T ARRIVE COLD.
Emma spends time with you ahead of the shoot. The territories you want to explore. A short brief goes to Allegro Captures so the edit is intentional.

"I always knew what I wanted to say. I just needed someone to ask the right questions."

On the day
THE CONVERSATION IS THE SHOOT.
No scripts. No re-takes. Just a conversation that happens to be captured. Nina timestamps anything remarkable. Dom catches every angle.
